assembly_name.title: Reference Genome Name
assembly_name.description: Display name for the reference genome shown in the browser (e.g. GRCh38, hg38, mm10) (optional)

fasta.title: Reference FASTA (optional)
fasta.description: Reference genome FASTA file. If not provided, it will be detected from the execution logs of the datasets the selected files come from.
fasta.errorMessage: Must be an uncompressed FASTA file (.fa, .fasta or .fna)

vcf.title: VCF Files
vcf.description: Variant calls in gzipped VCF format
vcf.errorMessage: Must be a bgzipped VCF file (.vcf.gz)

bigwig.title: BigWig Files
bigwig.description: Coverage or signal tracks in BigWig format
bigwig.errorMessage: Must be a BigWig file (.bigWig, .bigwig or .bw)

gff.title: GFF3 Files
gff.description: Gene annotations in bgzipped, tabix-indexed GFF3 format
gff.errorMessage: Must be a bgzipped GFF3 file (.gff3.gz or .gff.gz)
